description: This file defines functions related to quantized LSTM weight extraction and decomposition for NNAPI delegate in TensorFlow Lite. It contains function declarations for manipulating weight matrices, tensors, and biases used in quantized LSTM models.

methods.name: ExtractQuantLstmWeightsSubmatrix
methods.description: Extracts a submatrix of weights from the quantized LSTM weight tensor based on specified dimensions and offsets.

methods.name: DecomposeQuantLstmWeightsTensor
methods.description: Decomposes the concatenated quantized weights tensor into separate component vectors for different LSTM gates.

methods.name: SetWeightSubmatrixDims
methods.description: Sets dimensions for submatrices of weights and recurrent weights based on the full weight dimensions.

methods.name: DecomposeBiasTensor
methods.description: Splits the bias tensor into separate biases for input, cell, forget, and output gates.
